info.name: Eudora RBAC API
info.description: API collection for Eudora Role-Based Access Control system, featuring authentication, profile retrieval, user management, and roles/permissions management.

request.description: Checks the health status of the API service and its database connection.
Registers a new user and automatically assigns the default 'USER' role.

exec: console.log("Access token saved to collection variable 'token'");

request.description: Authenticates the user and sets the 'token' collection variable dynamically.
Returns details of the currently logged-in user profile, including roles and flat permissions list.
Lists all active users (excludes soft-deleted users). Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Gets a user with all roles and permissions. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Updates a user's details. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Soft deletes a user by setting the 'deletedAt' timestamp. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Assigns a role to a user. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Removes a role from a user. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Retrieves all configured roles and their permission listings. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a new role. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Gets details of a role by ID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Updates role details. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Deletes a role from the system. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Assigns a specific permission to a role. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Removes a permission from a role. Requires SUPER_ADMIN role.
Lists all available system permissions (action/subject pairs). Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a new institution campus. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Lists campuses with pagination.
Creates a new academic program under a campus. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Lists all academic programs.
Creates a new academic year. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a term within an academic year. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a class section under a program and academic year. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a course class under a term. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a student profile linked to a user. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Places a student in a class section. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Enrolls a student in a course class. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a guardian profile linked to a user. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Creates a new family household unit. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Adds a student or guardian profile to a family unit. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Defines relationship details between a guardian and student profile. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Lists all active, public plans. Accessible publicly.
Lists all plans including inactive and private ones. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
Gets details of a single plan by ID. Accessible publicly.

Gets subscription details by subscription ID. Requires ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.
